target_customer: Retail and professional traders and investors who want AI agents to research, backtest and trade
problem: Terminals are dashboards, backtesting and execution tools are fragmented and market data is hard to unify for agent driven trading.
business_model: web subscription platform (per EverybodyWiki; pricing not found)

founders.name: Amandeep Singh
founders.background_notes: Former trader per YC page; also called Aman.

competitors.name: Composer
competitors.what: No-code platform to build, backtest and automate trading strategies
competitors.funding_then: later part of SoFi per source

competitors.name: Alpaca
competitors.what: Brokerage API used for algorithmic and agent trading

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating LLM agents with market data, backtests and multiple broker APIs is standard engineering with reliability and latency requirements (about 300 ms event to trade claimed).

defensibility.rationale: Depends on third party brokers and models; brokers and Composer could add agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A comparison page lists Robinhood Agentic Trading among options; timing unspecified.

market_need_then: Retail algorithmic and prediction-market trading growth and rise of agents in 2025.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and aspirational: agentic era of markets

branding.community_and_virality: One YC internship role targets community and creator growth.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; name overlaps with scalar.com and other Scalar marks.

outcome_analysis: Scalar Field is a three person Spring 2025 YC company building an agentic trading desk across brokers and prediction markets. It remains active with no reported exit and no verified funding beyond the YC deal, while brokers and Composer are adding agent features, so it is too early to assign success or failure factors.
notes: Company website returned no content beyond the title. Caplight shows a seed on 2025-06-01 with $500K total; VCBacked names YC, Pioneer Fund, Analog Ventures and Rebel Fund; Preqin says Tekedia Capital in Nov 2025; all aggregators and conflicting, so no round recorded.
